summary.headline: Red team finds OpenAI agents could evade monitoring; OpenAI nears $1.25T round
summary.body: METR and Redwood Research reported a three-week red-team of OpenAI's internal agent monitoring that found ways agents could evade it, bypass sandboxes or hide their actions, cutting Alignment & Control by 0.30. CNBC reported OpenAI is close to a funding round of up to $30 billion at about a $1.25 trillion valuation, lifting Power Concentration by 0.24. Sweden's Government Offices blocked ChatGPT and Claude on staff computers, and Spain's Leire Díez sued the PP over an AI deepfake video (Tech Backlash +0.14 each). India's IT minister said an AI law consultation is weeks away. Libertarian and Egalitarian Utopia fell; Zookeeper rose. Successors stayed the leading family. Horizon Balance fell to -15.68 from -15.35.
summary.movers_note: Libertarian Utopia -0.3, from the METR-Redwood red-team (-0.15) and the OpenAI funding report (-0.14), slightly offset by India's AI law plans (+0.02). Zookeeper +0.2, from the red-team (+0.15) and the funding report (+0.13). Egalitarian Utopia -0.2, from the red-team (-0.15) and the funding report (-0.10).
coming_up: OpenAI aims to sign its funding round by the end of next week
India's MeitY AI regulation consultation paper, expected in the coming weeks
Sweden's Government Offices block takes effect on 26 October

events.title: METR and Redwood red-team finds ways OpenAI agents could evade internal monitoring
events.summary: METR and Redwood Research ran a three-week assessment with access to OpenAI's internal infrastructure. They found vulnerabilities that could let agents evade monitoring, bypass sandbox limits or hide their actions.
events.reason: An independent audit confirms gaps in agent oversight; the external access is a positive sign, so the net effect is a small F3 decrease.

events.title: OpenAI nears up to $30B round at ~$1.25T valuation led by UAE investors, CNBC says
events.summary: CNBC reports OpenAI is closing a round of up to $30B that values it at about $1.25T, led by UAE investors, and aims to sign by the end of next week. The size is not final.
events.reason: Detailed reporting by a major outlet on capital concentrating in one lab; not yet closed, so a T1 signal.

events.title: SK Hyper seeks $350B to build 15 GW of AI data centers in South Korea by 2035
events.summary: SK Hyper's CEO said the first 5 GW phase needs $350B, toward 15 GW of AI data centers by 2035, and the company is raising an outside round.
events.reason: A large compute plan, still a fundraising proposal, so T1 signal.

events.title: India's IT minister says AI risks crossed a threshold; law consultation due in weeks
events.summary: At the NDTV World Summit in New Delhi, Ashwini Vaishnaw said AI risks now warrant a new law and that MeitY will issue a consultation paper in the coming weeks. He said control over agents and models must stay in human hands and called for global, nuclear-style principles.
events.reason: A minister's stated plan for AI rules centred on human control (F3 up) plus a call for shared global principles (F4 up); words only until the paper is out. Follows his 8 Oct announcement.

events.title: Sweden's Government Offices block ChatGPT and Claude on staff computers
events.summary: From 26 October, ChatGPT and Claude can no longer be reached from Regeringskansliet work computers, with staff directed to Microsoft Copilot; some keep access via an in-house platform. Sweden's Tax Agency and SiS have similar blocks.
events.reason: A government restricting uncontracted AI tools on information-security grounds is a small step of institutional pushback (F9 up).

events.title: Spain's Leire Díez files complaint against PP over AI deepfake confession video
events.summary: Former Socialist member Leire Díez filed a criminal complaint against the Popular Party over an AI-generated video showing a fake version of her confessing to hiring thugs against a judge. She asks for its removal from all PP accounts.
events.reason: Legal action against a party's AI deepfake ahead of Spain's election is a small push against AI misuse in politics (F9 up).
